baseline.definition: Median pairwise max-norm distance between phenotypes of perturbed replicas, where phenotype is the logit vector on a frozen audit batch, measured at 25 percent of the training horizon.
baseline.known_limitation: Its predictive power is largely persistence: log10(final/early) spans only 0.31-0.35 decades. It is a diagnostic, not evidence of basin structure. This limitation is frozen with it so that no future work mistakes the baseline for a finding.
baseline.name: early functional spread
baseline.rule: A candidate predictor is admissible only if it adds HELD-OUT predictive information beyond {early functional spread, learning rate, early loss} jointly. Beating early loss alone is not sufficient and never was.
baseline.status: FROZEN — mandatory baseline for every future DISCOVERY-002 candidate
baseline.why_frozen: It beat every alternative in DISCOVERY-002 stages 3-4 and it is nearly free to compute. Any candidate that cannot beat it is not worth carrying.
